g.text: 01 / DBMS-NORMALIZATION
Interactive educational platform designed to master relational database normalization principles.
Decomposes schemas across 1NF, 2NF, 3NF and BCNF with functional dependency visual analysis.
JAVASCRIPT · REACT · ALGORITHMS · DATABASE DESIGN · VERCEL DEPLOYED
02 / DAILY-TASK-MANAGER-KANBAN
Full-featured keyboard and drag-and-drop productivity kanban board for agile task management.
Includes local state persistence, priority tagging, categorization filters, and fluid UX.
JAVASCRIPT · REACT · STATE MANAGEMENT · PRODUCTIVITY · 3★ STARS
03 / ODOO X LDCE HACKATHON 2026
Rapid prototype built for the Odoo x LDCE Hackathon 2026 solving real-world enterprise bottlenecks.
Integrated TypeScript frontend and backend modules with collaborative workflow pipeline.
TYPESCRIPT · REACT · NODE.JS · HACKATHON 2026 · TEAM COLLABORATION
04 / PINAK.OS & SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Personal developer ecosystem combining automation scripts, developer tooling, and telemetry.
Coordinates CI/CD profile synchronizations, Git workflows, and modular backend endpoints.
NODE.JS · TYPESCRIPT · GITHUB ACTIONS · AUTOMATION · DEV TOOLS
05 / BMS — BUSINESS MANAGEMENT SUITE
Comprehensive business management system designed for modular inventory and operation workflows.
Engineered with RESTful APIs, data validation schemas, and structured database models.
JAVASCRIPT · NODE.JS · EXPRESS · MONGODB · REST APIS
06 / TRIP-FRONTEND
Modern travel and itinerary planning web interface offering interactive destination discovery.
Features responsive layouts, dynamic route previews, and intuitive booking components.
JAVASCRIPT · REACT · CSS3 · VERCEL · INTERACTION DESIGN
